records.title: Late Breaking Results: FPGA-Aware Automatic Acceleration Framework for Vision Transformer with Mixed-Scheme Quantization
records.reason: ACM full text was unavailable. The record describes an FPGA-aware mixed-scheme quantization/acceleration framework for vision transformers, which is a plausible low-bit transformer hardware connection but vision-only and unverified in primary text.

records.title: Auto-Compressing Networks
records.reason: Auto-Compressing Networks studies removing computational redundancy in deep networks through automatic compression. The general mechanism may apply to transformers, but available paper evaluations do not establish direct LLM inference or serving gains.

records.title: Expanding before Inferring: Enhancing Factuality in Large Language Models through Premature Layers Interpolation
records.reason: The paper uses premature-layer interpolation to improve LLM factuality during inference. It targets factual correctness rather than reducing computation or latency; no efficiency gain is established.
